page.content:
Predicted path that shortens the dark age to a thousand years.

How Seldon Plan connects

  • Character: Hari Seldon — Seldon designs the Plan that the Foundations serve.
  • Character: The Mule — The Mule is the mutant the Seldon Plan did not include.
  • Concept: Psychohistory — Psychohistory is what makes the Seldon Plan calculable.
  • Character: R. Daneel Olivaw — Daneel later shepherds the long human Plan around Foundation.

What is Seldon Plan?

The Seldon Plan is the sequence of crises meant to replace Empire with a Second Empire in a thousand years instead of thirty thousand — unless the Mule breaks it.

Key threads lead to Hari Seldon, The Mule, Psychohistory and R. Daneel Olivaw.
